_why: WSG-6. Three different states returned `start_fresh` and only two of them mean it: no file, and a file that parsed and holds no record for this feature. A file that EXISTS and could not be read is neither -- the store may hold dozens of records and a live owner for this very feature, and `start_fresh` tells the caller to initialise over it. The incident that filed this was a state file that vanished with the cause undetermined; an unreadable file is the half a tool can defend against. An ABSENT file with no phase documents still answers start_fresh deliberately, so both directions are mutated; 2026-10-07 added the other half -- no record but live phase documents is state_lost.

mutations.name: an-unreadable-state-file-reads-as-nothing-claimed-again
mutations._mechanism: The defect itself. A truncated write over a populated store routes a second session to initialise a feature the first is actively working, and nothing downstream can tell that from a genuinely new feature.

mutations.name: an-absent-file-becomes-a-false-alarm
mutations._mechanism: The over-firing direction, which matters as much: a feature that was never started is the COMMON case, and answering cannot_judge there makes every first resume a false alarm. An alert that is usually wrong is ignored, and then the real one is ignored too.
mutations.find:
if not state_file.is_file():
        return _no_record(state_file, feature)  # M:RD-LOST-ABSENT

mutations.name: the-token-leaves-the-decision-table
mutations._mechanism: A token nobody documented is one every caller's enumeration misclassifies by whatever its default is. An operator who hits cannot_judge with no prescribed action falls back to guessing, and the obvious guess is to treat it like start_fresh.
mutations.find: | `cannot_judge` | The state file EXISTS and could not be read
mutations.replace: | `cannot_judged` | The state file EXISTS and could not be read

mutations.name: a-lost-record-with-phase-docs-starts-fresh-again
mutations._mechanism: 2026-10-07: a vanished state file over a feature with phase documents through Phase 6 answered start_fresh, routing a Phase-6 feature to Phase 1. The document probe is the guard; reporting no documents restores the defect on both the absent-file and the no-record paths.

mutations.name: the-no-record-path-skips-the-document-probe
mutations._mechanism: The parsed-file-without-the-record half: a store that lost ONE record (a bad merge, a hand edit) is the same incident with the file still present.

mutations.name: the-absent-file-path-skips-the-document-probe
mutations._mechanism: The observed shape itself: no state file at all, documents through Phase 6.

mutations.name: an-unsearchable-docs-tree-reads-as-no-documents
mutations._mechanism: could-not-look collapsed into found-nothing, one level below WSG-6: a permission error on docs/ answers start_fresh over a feature that may be mid-flight.

mutations.name: state-lost-leaves-the-decision-table
mutations._mechanism: An undocumented token is classified by each caller's default; h-mad's routing sentence would claim and create on it.
